known_results: All existing Moller, Walsh, recovery, and genome-neighborhood headline results are known. These checks are not a new confirmatory test or an untouched validation cohort.
purpose: Assess domination by large or influential clonal complexes and accurately qualify uncertainty, without changing predictors.
analyses: Recompute every primary design/phage metric from saved out-of-fold predictions and assert agreement with existing metric tables.

For each of 15 Moller CCs, omit that CC from scoring only and recompute macro Spearman, R2 and MAE contrasts. Keep original predictions; this is an influence analysis, not a refit or leave-one-CC-out validation.
Compute each CC/phage MAE and equally average across CCs and phages; report the number of CCs whose mean MAE favors random evaluation. Do not average unstable small-CC R2 or correlation.
For each of six Walsh CCs, omit that CC from scoring and report AUROC and AP contrast. Mark one-class subsets unavailable.

For each Moller CC, omit its hosts and all incident pairs from the genome similarity audit; compute same-CC AUC and within-minus-between median similarity. Report ranges as sensitivity ranges, never confidence intervals.
Report CC counts and inverse concentration 1/sum(p_CC squared) descriptively; this is not an estimated effective sample size.
Record all inputs with SHA256 and retain all results regardless of direction.
prohibitions: No model fitting or hyperparameter selection
No changes to frozen original artifacts
No treating scoring-only omission ranges as confidence intervals
